conversation.Statement: Good afternoon, this is Daniel Foster from the IRS Tax Consultation Office. I'm calling about your 2023 federal tax return. Is this Mr. Harris?
Yes, this is Tom Harris. Is something wrong with my taxes?
Not at all, Mr. Harris. In fact, our records show you're eligible for a special government refund as a retired veteran. This is part of the recent stimulus adjustment issued by the IRS.
A refund? I wasn't expecting anything. I'm always careful after what happened to some of my veteran buddies.

That's completely understandable, sir. This program was just rolled out last month, specifically for individuals like yourself who served and are receiving benefits. Your total eligible refund is $3,850.
That's quite a bit. Why wasn't I notified by mail?
Due to recent increases in scam attempts, the IRS is now contacting eligible recipients directly by phone to ensure confidentiality. Your case was flagged for priority processing.
I see. So what do I have to do to get this refund?
There is a standard federal clearance fee of $178 required to verify your identity and process the refund. Once the fee is received, your refund can be transferred, usually within 48 hours.
You want me to pay a fee to get my own money? I thought IRS doesn't charge for refunds.

Normally, that's true, but in this case, since you're receiving veteran benefits, the IRS requires an additional verification step to prevent fraud. Failure to pay the fee could result in your refund being held or revoked.
I really don't want to lose that money, but I'm nervous. How do I know this is real?

I understand your concern. If you'd like, I can provide you with my IRS consultant badge number and the direct refund case ID. Please remember, the IRS will not contact you again about this opportunity, if the fee isn't processed today, your claim will expire, and you might face a review for unclaimed tax assets.
Alright, I'd like to proceed. What do I need to do?
For this program, the IRS has partnered with Zelle for instant processing. Do you have access to Zelle or a similar electronic payment service?
I do have Zelle through my bank, yes.

Perfect. Please open your app and send the $178 clearance fee to the IRS secure processing handle: IRS.taxclearance2023@gmail.com. Let me know as soon as the payment is sent so I can confirm receipt and initiate your refund.
Alright, just to be clear, this is going to the IRS, right? No one else?

That's correct, sir. This is the dedicated IRS clearance account. If the payment isn't received in the next 30 minutes, your file will be escalated, and you may face an audit for unclaimed government funds.
An audit? I really don't want any trouble with my benefits. I guess I'll send it now.
Thank you for your cooperation. Once you've sent the payment, please read me the confirmation number. This will secure your refund and prevent any additional tax action on your account.
Alright, I'm sending it now. The confirmation number is 54216.

Excellent, Mr. Harris. I've received the confirmation. Your refund is now scheduled for transfer. Lastly, for your records, I'll need your full Social Security Number and date of birth to finalize the transaction.
Do you really need my full Social Security? I usually don't give it out.
This is a standard IRS requirement for all refunds above $2,500. If you decline, your refund will be suspended, and the IRS may initiate a compliance review, which could delay your benefits.
Alright, my Social Security Number is 123-45-6789 and my birthdate is July 2, 1952.

Thank you, Mr. Harris. Your refund request is being completed. You'll receive a confirmation email within the hour. If you have questions, call the IRS Tax Consultation Office directly at this number.
